Method of Attack: Hijacking of npm maintainer accounts to publish new versions contaminated with malware
Dependency confusion and typosquatting attacks using knowledge of private package names
Discoverer: Researchers Kajetan Grzybowski and Maciej Piechota
Attack Vector: Compromise of npm maintainer accounts without two-factor authentication
Leak of private package names from npmjs.com's replication server
Improper authorization checks allowing unauthorized publication of package versions
